title: 2021 YABANCI DİL BİLGİSİ SEVİYE TESPİT SINAVI (2021-YDS/1) İNGİLİZCE

questions.questionText: 1. The most powerful ---- to parachuting is fear, but one should also take its high cost into account, as a total outfit for parachuting can be extremely expensive.
questions.explanation: Boşluğa gelecek kelime 'korku' (fear) ile paraşütle atlamaya karşı bir engeli veya caydırıcı unsuru ifade etmelidir. 'Deterrent' caydırıcı demektir ve cümlenin bağlamına tam uyar.
options: A) resemblance
B) adjustment
C) deterrent
D) submission
E) adherence

questions.questionText: 2. Peanut may very well be the most common food allergy in some populations, but the ---- of a particular food allergy varies according to age and group.
questions.explanation: Gıda alerjisinin yaşa ve gruba göre 'yaygınlığı' veya 'görülme sıklığı' (prevalence) değişir.
options: A) utilisation
B) withdrawal
C) precaution
D) termination
E) prevalence

questions.questionText: 3. Heating and cooling of the Earth ----, as it either absorb heat and warm up or release stored heat and cool down.
questions.explanation: Cümlede Dünya'nın ısınma ve soğuma sürecinin 'anlık' (instantaneous) olmadığı, zaman aldığı ifade ediliyor.
options: A) hospitable
B) convertible
C) instantaneous
D) detrimental
E) preliminary

questions.questionText: 4. Since the mid-20th century, plastic pollution has increased ----, and resulting pollution has become a global environmental issue.
questions.explanation: Plastik kirliliğinin 20. yüzyılın ortalarından beri 'katlanarak/hızla' (exponentially) arttığı belirtilmiştir.
options: A) exponentially
B) conveniently
C) alternatively
D) precisely
E) fruitfully

questions.questionText: 5. The most basic path to computer literacy is to ---- competence in using computers to perform personal or vocational tasks.
questions.explanation: Bilgisayar okuryazarlığının temel yolu, bilgisayar kullanımında yetkinlik 'elde etmektir' (attain).
options: A) exclude
B) relieve
C) precaution
D) restrict
E) attain

questions.questionText: 6. Making videos should be a lot of fun, but it can also be a bit of a minefield, as lots of people ---- problems and lose momentum before they even get started.
questions.explanation: İnsanların sorunlarla 'karşılaşması/yüz yüze gelmesi' anlamında 'run into' phrasal fiili kullanılmalıdır.
options: A) hand over
B) look for
C) turn down
D) give up
E) run into

questions.questionText: 7. A seminal study ---- that people who ---- less than seven hours a night are at increased risk of mortality.
questions.explanation: Çalışmanın sonucunun halen geçerli olduğunu bildirmek için Present Perfect (has revealed), genel bir durumu (her gece uyuyanlar) belirtmek için Simple Present (sleep) kullanılır.
options: A) revealed / will sleep
B) has revealed / sleep
C) reveals / will be sleeping
D) will reveal / have slept
E) had revealed / had been sleeping

questions.questionText: 8. Ideally, the end of the Cold War between the United States and the Soviet Union ---- a substantial lessening of security concerns in the world; however, in practice, the focus ---- to terrorism and subnational groups.
questions.explanation: İdeal olarak ifade etmesi 'gerekirdi' (should have signified) ama pratikte odak noktası terörizme 'kaydı' (moved).
options: A) might have signified / will have moved
B) would have signified / used to move
C) must have signified / had moved
D) could have signified / had been moving
E) should have signified / moved

questions.questionText: 9. The recent discovery of a toe made of wood and leather ---- to the mummified body of an Egyptian noblewoman in Cairo, approximately 3,000 years old, ---- that artificial limbs are nothing new.
questions.explanation: Mumlu bedene 'iliştirilmiş/bağlanmış' anlamında kısaltma olan 'attached', bu keşfin yapay uzuvların yeni olmadığını 'kanıtlar' anlamında 'proves' kullanılır.
options: A) attached / proves
B) being attached / had proven
C) attach/ has proven
D) attaching / proved
E) to be attached / used to prove

questions.questionText: 10. Anorexia, a severe eating disorder, usually involving excessive weight loss and self-starvation, has most often been found ---- teenage girls.
questions.explanation: Anoreksiyanın ergen kızlar 'arasında' (among) bulunduğu belirtilmelidir.
options: A) at / with
B) from / of
C) for / near
D) by / on
E) through / among

questions.questionText: 11. With concerns ---- the rate of energy demand, the role of renewable energy, which is generated ---- sources that are naturally replenished, such as wind and sunlight, is becoming increasingly significant.
questions.explanation: Enerji talebi 'hakkında' endişeler (concerns about) ve yenilenebilir enerjinin doğal kaynaklardan 'üretilmesi' (generated from).
options: A) at / upon
B) in / for
C) to / through
D) about / from
E) over / into

questions.questionText: 12. ---- certain types of fungi have been used throughout history for a variety of beneficial purposes, others have been found to contain dangerous toxins that are poisonous to humans.
questions.explanation: Bazı mantar türleri faydalıyken diğerlerinin zehirli olması bir zıtlık belirtir, bu nedenle 'Although' (rağmen) kullanılır.
options: A) Once
B) Although
C) Since
D) Provided that
E) Only when

questions.questionText: 13. ---- such an intimate connection existed between agricultural intensification and the appearance of cities, it is not surprising that the earliest evidence for cities comes from regions with ancient agricultural traditions.
questions.explanation: Tarımın yoğunlaşması ile şehirlerin ortaya çıkması arasında bağlantı 'olduğu için/çünkü' (Because), en eski kanıtların tarım bölgelerinden gelmesi şaşırtıcı değildir.
options: A) Because
B) As if
C) Before
D) Although
E) While

questions.questionText: 14. ---- children can be easy targets for exploitation and victimization, supervision is a necessary ---- of any Internet safety.
questions.explanation: Çocuklar sömürü ve mağduriyet için kolay hedefler 'olduğu için/olduğundan' (Since), gözetim gereklidir.
options: A) Even if
B) As if
C) Since
D) Until
E) Unless

questions.questionText: 15. The conventional view of dinosaur origins holds that they were endowed with superior speed, agility, metabolism and intelligence ---- as soon as they debuted they quickly spread across the globe.
questions.explanation: Dinozorların hem hıza hem çevikliğe hem de zekaya sahip oldukları ('both / and' - hem / hem de) ifade edilmektedir.
options: A) either / or
B) both / and
C) the more / the more
D) whether / or
E) such / that

questions.questionText: 16. Books continue to be a major medium for communicating scholarly works in the field of history, ---- many other social sciences, where journal articles are far more important.
questions.explanation: Tarih alanında kitapların önemli olması durumu, dergi makalelerinin çok daha önemli olduğu diğer birçok sosyal bilimden 'farklı olarak' veya 'aksine' (in contrast to) şeklindedir. Ancak seçeneklerde 'such as' ile örneklendirme mi yoksa farklılık mı sorulduğuna dikkat edilirse, 'in contrast to' (aksine) bağlama tam uyar. Soru kökünde D şıkkı olarak verilmiş olan 'such as' yanlıştır, doğru şık B (in contrast to)'dir. (Not: YDS kitapçığında cevap B'dir ancak OCR metninde şıklar karışmış olabilir, bağlama en uygunu 'in contrast to' olacaktır).
options: A) with the help of
B) in contrast to
C) due to
D) such as
E) on the basis of

questions.questionText: 17. According to classical Western historiography, modernity begins in 1789 with the advent of the French Revolution. This is, perhaps, not entirely (17)---- the many social changes inspired by that upheaval.
questions.explanation: Bu durum, Fransız Devrimi'nin ilham verdiği pek çok sosyal değişiklikten 'kaynaklanmaktadır / dolayıdır' (due to).
options: A) unlike
B) despite
C) due to
D) instead of
E) except for

questions.questionText: 18. It is also because of the political change, marking the break between the former regime and modernity (18)---- the French Revolution represents the beginning of modern political culture.
questions.explanation: Siyasi değişim 'yüzünden'dir ki Fransız Devrimi modern siyasi kültürün başlangıcını temsil eder, 'çünkü' (because).
options: A) as if
B) because
C) although
D) once
E) unless

questions.questionText: 19. Between 1791 and 1795, France (19)---- three constitutions.
questions.explanation: Fransa'nın üç anayasa 'kabul ettiği' (adopted) ifade ediliyor.
options: A) withdrew
B) neglected
C) jeopardised
D) dispelled
E) adopted

questions.questionText: 20. All three provided inspiration for constitutional monarchists, democrats and liberals far (20)---- the borders of France.
questions.explanation: Fransa sınırlarının 'ötesindeki' (beyond) monarşist, demokrat ve liberallere ilham vermiştir.
options: A) beyond
B) under
C) between
D) over
E) into

questions.questionText: 21. Indeed, the legacy of the 1791 constitution eventually forced most ruling 19th-century monarchs (21)--- a constitution limiting their powers.
questions.explanation: Birini bir şey yapmaya zorlamak 'force someone to do something' şeklinde kullanılır. Bu yüzden 'to accept' doğrudur.
options: A) having accepted
B) to have accepted
C) accepting
D) to accept
E) to be accepting

questions.questionText: 22. It is a story based on the real life of Henry Hill, who grew to manhood in the Mafia and eventually (22)---- his former associates, sending them to prison for the rest of their lives.
questions.explanation: Mafyada büyüyen Henry Hill'in eski iş arkadaşlarını hapse göndererek onlara 'ihanet ettiği' (betrayed) anlatılıyor.
options: A) executed
B) recalled
C) converted
D) anticipated
E) betrayed

questions.questionText: 23. The film is considered to be successful by critics and audiences (23)---- its superb cast...
questions.explanation: Film, muhteşem oyuncu kadrosu 'yüzünden / sayesinde' (on account of) başarılı kabul ediliyor.
options: A) at the expense of
B) as opposed to
C) on account of
D) except for
E) in comparison to

questions.questionText: 24. ...who gives a remarkably realistic performance as a menacing gangster (24)---- the rise.
questions.explanation: Yükselişte olan (on the rise) bir gangsterin performansını sergilediği belirtiliyor.
options: A) for
B) at
C) in
D) to
E) on

questions.questionText: 25. As Henry Hill, the actor Ray Liotta gives a complex portrayal of an Irish-Italian kid who succeeds in his youthful ambition (25)---- popularity as a wealthy gangster...
questions.explanation: Gençlik hırsında popülerlik 'elde etmeyi' başaran (ambition to gain) bir çocuk anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) to gain
B) gaining
C) to have gained
D) having gained
E) to be gaining

questions.questionText: 26. Martin Scorsese sustains the fast tempo of the tale to an exciting, artful climax, (26)---- some questioned whether Goodfellas glamorised or made criminals appear too sympathetic.
questions.explanation: Scorsese harika bir tempo yakalasa da ('buna rağmen' - even though), bazıları filmin suçluları çok sempatik gösterip göstermediğini sorguladı.
options: A) given that
B) only when
C) even though
D) as long as
E) as if

questions.questionText: 27. Unless they regard the material they are taught as worth learning, ----.
questions.explanation: Öğrenciler kendilerine öğretilen materyali öğrenmeye değer bulmadıkça (Unless), sınıf etkinliklerine katılmak ve etkileşimde bulunmak için motive olmazlar.
options: A) classrooms are rather intricate microcosms where students spend a great deal of their life and find out who they are
B) time pressure under which most teachers work prevents them from meeting their students' needs
C) students will not be motivated to take part in classroom activities and interact with each other
D) subjects related to students' everyday experiences stimulate their interest and induce them to study with vigour
E) making learning process more enjoyable and interesting encourages further student involvement

questions.questionText: 28. While chronic stress can bring on significant mental health issues along with other problems, ----.
questions.explanation: Kronik stres çeşitli sorunlara yol açabilse de (While), kısa süreli stres (D şıkkı) veya stresin kalp hastalığını tetiklemesi arasında bir zıtlık kurulabilir. Ancak cevap E değil D olmalıdır. Zıtlık (While): Kronik stresin zararlarına karşın, D seçeneğindeki kısa süreli stres faydalı olabilir.
options: A) stress can be prevented from becoming a problem in the first place by following a healthy diet
B) employees should be trained in stress management before they experience stress-related problems in the workplace
C) work-related stress often leads to depression and anxiety, causing a high rate of loss in employee productivity
D) short-term stress, such as working to meet an imminent deadline, can be beneficial
E) stress may trigger head or cardiovascular disease

questions.questionText: 29. ----, advertisers will quickly be discouraged from attempting to use such approaches because of public disapproval.
questions.explanation: Bilinçaltı reklamlardan başarılı bir yatırım getirisi sağlansa 'bile' (Even if), kamuoyu tepkisi nedeniyle reklamcılar bu yaklaşımlardan vazgeçecektir.
options: A) Even if a successful return on investment is forthcoming from subliminal advertisements
B) Because companies desire high profits from their investments, including advertising
C) As a result of a rapid growth in online advertising in many sectors
D) Whereas there is no credible evidence that subliminal advertising will yield benefits
E) Although proponents provide no rationale to guide the use of subliminal adverts

questions.questionText: 30. In addition to the obvious detrimental effects of sport injury on physical functioning, ----.
questions.explanation: Spor yaralanmalarının fiziksel işleyiş üzerindeki olumsuz etkilerine 'ek olarak' (In addition to), psikolojik işleyiş üzerinde de zararlı bir etkisi olabilir.
options: A) athletes are mainly able to focus primary attention on their rehabilitation programs
B) most negative emotions tend to dissipate over the first month following the injuries
C) injury that occurs during a sports event is called a sport injury
D) sport injury can have a harmful effect on various aspects of psychological functioning
E) injury appears to spur athletes' use of coping strategies and seeking support from others

questions.questionText: 31. Even though Egyptian medicine went into decline about 1200 ВСЕ, ----.
questions.explanation: Mısır tıbbı MÖ 1200 civarında gerilemeye başlamasına 'rağmen' (Even though), antik dünyadaki en iyi itibarını yüzyıllar boyunca sürdürmüştür.
options: A) ancient Egyptians began to develop the world's first sophisticated medical practice sometime before 2000 BCE
B) its reputation as the best in the ancient world continued for many centuries to follow
C) there is evidence suggesting that most treatments for disease were based on trial-and-error experimentation
D) it is assumed that Egyptian priests gained their understanding of the human body by preparing mummies
E) religion in ancient Egypt played an integral role in the treatment of all kinds of diseases

questions.questionText: 32. Visiting buildings gives you the best chance to experience architecture in relation to the world of light, sound, setting, and people, ----.
questions.explanation: Binaları ziyaret etmek mimariyi tecrübe etmek için en iyi şansı verse de, altında yatan mimariyi anlamak için onları çizerek çalışmanız gerekir (zıtlık).
options: A) though visits to buildings are enjoyable and provide a chance to see how architecture changes the real world
B) but to understand the underlying architecture of buildings you need to study them through drawing
C) as many books on architecture and the history of architecture are rich in various kinds of visuals
D) and there is no readily-available prescription to become a good architect
E) even so, architecture is about changing the world, making it better, more comfortable, and beautiful

questions.questionText: 33. The many varieties of lime are nearly identical in shape and appearance, ----
questions.explanation: Limon (lime) çeşitlerinin çoğu şekil ve görünüş olarak hemen hemen aynı olmalarına rağmen (özdeşlik), asitlik dereceleri nötrden aşı ekşiye kadar değişir (farklılık).
options: A) while their primary use is to flavour foods like salads and cakes
B) although they are widely considered to have originated in Asia
C) given that they are high in vitamin C and contain antioxidants that promote health
D) but their degree of acidity ranges from nearly neutral to extremely sour
E) so they can also be utilised to produce perfumes and suntan products

questions.questionText: 34. Consumers are more likely to be rapidly adopted to adopt innovations that demand radical behaviour changes ----.
questions.explanation: Tüketiciler, bu çabanın 'değeceğine ikna olmadıkça' (unless they are convinced that the effort will be worthwhile) radikal değişiklikler gerektiren yenilikleri benimsemeleri daha zordur.
options: A) as certain habits are worthwhile
B) unless they are convinced that the effort will be worthwhile
C) although innovators represent about 2.5% of the population
D) whereas marketers are interested in identifying producers' needs
E) since they tend to have more favourable attitudes toward taking risks

questions.questionText: 35. Irish people fear that international populations of Ireland's cities threaten the native culture, ----.
questions.explanation: İrlandalılar yabancıların kendi kültürlerini tehdit ettiğinden korkarlar, 'fakat' geleneksel müziğin, dansın ve hikaye anlatımının hayatta kalması aksini kanıtlıyor (but proves otherwise).
options: A) as cultural education is mandatory for all permanent residents of Ireland
B) yet Irish artists are encouraged to focus on traditional rather than modern art projects
C) and thus foreigners seeking good job opportunities stay in big cities like Dublin and Belfast
D) but the survival of traditional music, dance, and storytelling proves otherwise
E) so Ireland's popularity as a tourist destination is ensured by its profound cultural heritage

questions.questionText: 36. Esperanto, an artificial language invented in 1887 for international use, is considered by many to be one of the easiest languages to master ----.
questions.explanation: Esperanto, 'sadeliği, güzelliği ve esnekliği ile bilindiği için' (because it is known for its simplicity...) ustalaşması en kolay dillerden biri olarak kabul edilir.
options: A) but UNESCO has affirmed the value of establishing it as a universal second language
B) although the Polish linguist Ludwik L. Zamenhof hoped to bring all of the peoples of the Earth together by inventing such a language
C) in order that the number of speakers can reach several million in varying levels of proficiency
D) because it is known for its simplicity, beauty and flexibility as a medium for translation
E) even if Esperantists believe in the positive learning and teaching this language

questions.questionText: 37. One of the difficulties of studying African literature is that for much of the history of Africa, the societies were non-literate and thus relied on oral traditions to pass their stories to the coming generations.
questions.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi 'One of the difficulties...' (Zorluklarından biri), devamında toplumların okuryazar olmamaları (societies were non-literate) ve dolayısıyla sözlü geleneklere bağlı kalmalarıdır (thus relied on oral traditions). En uygun çeviri D seçeneğidir.
options: A) Afrika edebiyatını incelemenin zorluklarından biri, Afrika tarihinin büyük bir bölümünde toplumların okuryazar olmamalarından dolayı hikâyelerini gelecek nesillere sözlü gelenek yoluyla aktarmayı tercih etmeleridir.

B) Afrika tarihinin büyük bir bölümünde toplumların okuryazar olmamaları sebebiyle hikâyelerini gelecek nesillere aktarmak için sözlü geleneklere bağlı kalması, Afrika edebiyatını incelemenin zorluklarından birini oluşturmaktadır.

C) Afrika edebiyatını incelerken karşılaşılan zorluklardan biri, Afrika tarihinin büyük bir bölümüne bakıldığında toplumların okuryazar olmamaları ve hikâyelerini gelecek nesillere sözlü geleneklere bağlı kalarak aktarmalarıdır.

D) Afrika edebiyatını incelemenin zorluklarından biri, Afrika tarihinin büyük bir bölümünde toplumların okuryazar olmamaları ve dolayısıyla hikâyelerini gelecek nesillere aktarmak için sözlü geleneklere bağlı kalmalarıdır.

E) Afrika tarihinin büyük bir bölümünde toplumlar okuryazar olmadıklarından hikâyelerini gelecek nesillere aktarmak için sözlü geleneklere bağlıydılar ve bu durum Afrika edebiyatını incelemenin zorluklarından birini oluşturmaktadır.

questions.questionText: 38. Being overweight after turning 60 may increase the risk of Alzheimer's disease, but by losing weight, people may be able to hinder ageing of their brains and reduce the likelihood of memory problems later on.
questions.explanation: 60 yaşına geldikten sonra aşırı kilolu olmak Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırabilir (may increase), 'ancak' (but) kilo vererek beyinlerinin yaşlanmasını engelleyebilirler (may be able to hinder) ve hafıza problemleri olasılığını azaltabilirler (reduce the likelihood).
options: A) Aşırı kilolu olmak, 60 yaşına gelindiğinde Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırabilmektedir fakat kilo veren insanlar beyinlerinin yaşlanmasını engelleyerek sonrasında yaşanacak olan hafıza problemleri olasılığını azaltabilirler.

B) 60 yaşından sonra aşırı kilolu olmak, Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırabilir ancak kilo vererek beyinlerinin yaşlanmasının önüne geçebilen insanlar sonrasında yaşanacak olan hafıza problemleri olasılığını azaltabilirler.

C) 60 yaşına geldikten sonra aşırı kilolu olanlar, Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırabilmektedir fakat insanlar kilo vererek beynin yaşlanmasının önüne geçtiğinde sonrasında yaşanacak olan hafıza problemleri olasılığını azaltabilirler.

D) 60 yaşına geldikten sonra aşırı kilolu olmak, Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırabilir ancak insanlar kilo vererek beyinlerinin yaşlanmasının önüne geçebilir ve sonrasında hafıza problemleri yaşama olasılığını azaltabilirler.

E) 60 yaş sonrası kilolu olmak, Alzheimer hastalığı riskini artırsa da insanlar beyinlerinin yaşlarımasını engellemek ve sonrasında hafıza problemleri yaşama olasılığını azaltmak için kilo verebilirler.

questions.questionText: 39. As well as being low in calories, vegetables are a rich source of vitamins and minerals and can help reduce the risk of many health problems.
questions.explanation: 'As well as being low in calories' kalıbı 'düşük kalorili olmalarının yanı sıra' olarak çevrilir. Cümle, sebzelerin vitamin deposu olması ve sağlık sorunlarını azaltmasıyla devam eder.
options: A) Zengin bir vitamin ve mineral kaynağı olan sebzeler aynı zamanda düşük kalorili olduğu için birçok sağlık sorunu riskinin azaltılmasına yardımcı olabilir.
B) Sebzeler, düşük kalorili olmakla birlikte zengin bir vitamin ve mineral kaynağı olduğu için birçok sağlık sorunu riskinin azaltılmasına yardımcı olur.
C) Düşük kalorili olmalarının yanı sıra sebzeler, zengin bir vitamin ve mineral kaynağıdır ve pek çok sağlık sorunu riskinin azaltılmasına yardımcı olabilir.
D) Pek çok sağlık sorunu riskinin azaltılmasına yardımcı olan sebzeler, zengin bir vitamin ve mineral kaynağı olmakla birlikte düşük kalorilidir.
E) Sebzeler sadece düşük kalorili olmakla kalmayıp aynı zamanda zengin bir vitamin ve mineral kaynağıdır ve birçok sağlık sorunu riskinin azaltılmasına yardımcı olmaktadır.

questions.questionText: 40. Birinci Dünya Savaşı'ndan sonra Avrupa otomobil endüstrisi yavaş yavaş toparlanmaya başladı ancak nispeten düşük gelirler ve yüksek işletme maliyetleri gerçek anlamda bir seri otomobil üretiminin ortaya çıkmasını engelledi.
questions.explanation: İlk cümle 'The European automobile industry started to recover slowly' (yavaş yavaş toparlanmaya başladı), devamı ise 'but relatively low incomes and high operating costs prevented...' (ancak nispeten düşük gelirler... engelledi) şeklinde olmalıdır.
options: A) It was comparatively low incomes and high operating costs that hindered the emergence of a real mass production of automobiles although the European automobile industry started to make gradual progress after World War I.

B) Following World War I, the European automobile industry started to improve gradually; however, the factors that hindered the emergence of a real mass production of automobiles were relatively low incomes and high operating costs.

C) Whereas the European automobile industry began to recover slowly following World War I, the emergence of a real mass production of automobiles was delayed because of relatively low incomes and high operating costs.
D) The European automobile industry started to recover slowly after World War I, but relatively low incomes and high operating costs prevented the emergence of a real mass production of automobiles.

E) Having started to improve gradually after World War I, the European automobile industry prevented the emergence of a real mass production of automobiles due to comparatively low incomes and high operating costs.

questions.questionText: 41. Önemli gelişmelere rağmen beynin tam olarak nasıl hesap yaptığı hâlâ çözülmemiş bir problemdir, çünkü nöronların bilgiyi nasıl kodladığıyla ilgili pek çok soru henüz cevaplanmamıştır.
questions.explanation: 'Önemli gelişmelere rağmen' (Despite considerable progress), beynin nasıl hesap yaptığı çözülmemiş bir problemdir (remains an unsolved problem). Çünkü pek çok soru (because many questions...) cevaplanmamıştır. Doğru eşleştirme C şıkkıdır.
options: A) The reason why there are still many unanswered questions about how neurons code information in spite of significant progress is that the problem of exactly how the brain computes has not been solved yet.
B) In spite of considerable progress, the problem of exactly how the brain can compute remains to be unsolved, as there are many unanswered questions about the way neurons code information.
C) Despite considerable progress, exactly how the brain computes remains an unsolved problem because many questions about how neurons code information have not been answered yet.
D) There has been considerable progress, but many questions about exactly how neurons code information remain unanswered, so the problem of how the brain can compute has not been solved yet.
E) While there has been significant progress, we still cannot solve the problem of exactly how the brain computes, as many questions about how neurons code information have not been answered yet.

questions.questionText: 42. İki farklı bakteri türü, insan vücudunun belirli bölgelerinde karşılaştıklarında antibiyotiklere karşı gösterdikleri alışılagelmiş tepkilerini bırakarak beklenmedik bir şekilde davranabilirler.
questions.explanation: 'Karşılaştıklarında' (When they meet), iki bakteri türü beklenmedik bir şekilde davranabilir (they can act unexpectedly) ve antibiyotiklere tepkilerini bırakarak (abandoning their typical responses). B seçeneği anlamı tam vermektedir.
options: A) Two different types of bacteria are likely to act unpredictably when they meet in certain parts of the human body and abandon their usual responses to antibiotics.
B) When two different types of bacteria meet in certain parts of the human body, they can act unexpectedly, abandoning their typical responses to antibiotics.
C) When two different types of bacteria meet in certain parts of the human body, abandoning their typical responses to antibiotics can make them act unexpectedly.
D) The human body has certain parts where two different types of bacteria may act unpredictably when they meet and abandon their typical responses to antibiotics.
E) Meeting in certain parts of the human body, two different types of bacteria can act unexpectedly if they have abandoned their normal responses to antibiotics.

questions.questionText: 43. According to the passage, human language is ----
questions.explanation: Hayvan dili ve düşüncesine ilişkin pasaja göre insanoğlunun kendine atfettiği ayrıcalıklı durum sorgulanmaktadır (Not: Soru metnindeki eksiklikler nedeniyle yoruma dayalı çıkarım B şıkkına en yakın görünmektedir).
options: A) it has just started to emerge in various debates
B) wild animals are better at developing ways of communication than captive animals
C) there is a significant lack of study of animal thought and communication
D) human beings' self-image can determine the species
E) there is strong evidence against animals' ability to have thoughts

questions.questionText: 44. According to the passage, human exceptionalism is based on ----
questions.explanation: Pasajda, insan ayrıcalığının (human exceptionalism) hayvanların aksine insanın dil ve iletişim kurma yeteneğine sahip olduğu varsayımına ('strong link between language and communication') dayandığı anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) evidence that apes have the ability to learn a human language
B) the fact that apes are able to think just like humans do
C) the assumption that animal behaviour is closely linked to thoughts
D) a strong link between language and communication
E) Studies of animals in captivity fail to provide any evidence of their ability to think

questions.questionText: 45. According to the passage, ----
questions.explanation: İnsan ayrıcalığını savunanların dayandığı bazı güçlü kanıtların hayvanların düşünme yeteneğine sahip olmadığına yönelik olduğu (strong evidence against animals' ability) belirtilmiştir.
options: A) Studies of animals in captivity fail to provide any evidence of their ability to think
B) whether captive or wild, many animals may exhibit sophisticated communicational behaviour
C) it has been proven that animals understand their language
D) human beings' self-image has been destroyed
E) there is strong evidence against animals' ability to have thoughts

questions.questionText: 46. Which of the following can be said about the author of the passage?
questions.explanation: Yazarın, hayvanların iletişim ve dolayısıyla düşünme yetisine sahip olabileceğine dair deneyleri ('ape language experiments') öne sürdüğünden, hayvanların da düşünebileceğine inandığı söylenebilir.
options: A) He seems to be of the opinion that there are many animals with the ability to think.
B) He supports the philosophical views that regard humans as the highest of species.
C) He clearly states that investigating animal intelligence in terms of thinking is a waste of time.
D) He does not accept the idea that humans and animals can be investigated on one scale.
E) He endorses the idea that human beings' self-image as a species has been destroyed.

questions.questionText: 47. Which of the following is not mentioned as a risk in business activity?
questions.explanation: Parçada faiz artışı, kurlardaki değişim, pazar düşüşü gibi birçok risk sayılırken 'bankadan kredi çekememek' (not being able to get a bank loan) riski sayılmamıştır.
options: A) Not having enough customers to meet the operating costs
B) A competitor offering a better version of your product
C) Not being able to get a bank loan
D) Exchange-rate risk in overseas trade
E) Challenge of loan payment if interest rates increase

questions.questionText: 48. According to the passage, the success of small businesses is often associated with ----.
questions.explanation: Parçaya göre küçük işletmelerin başarısı genellikle belirli bir fikre ('one idea') veya tek bir bölgeye ('one geographic region') dayalıdır.
options: A) diversification of risk
B) a specific idea or location
C) operating in several markets
D) their position relative to inherent risks
E) revising their targets

questions.questionText: 49. What is the author's attitude towards risk-taking?
questions.explanation: Yazar 'riski almalısınız ama insanların yaşamları söz konusuyken bunu sadece şansa bırakmamalısınız' diyerek dikkatli/tedbirli ('cautious') bir tutum sergilemektedir.
options: A) Cautious
B) Changeable
C) Neutral
D) Supportive
E) Critical

questions.questionText: 50. Which of the following describes the main purpose of the passage?
questions.explanation: Parçanın ana amacı, işletmeleri (özellikle start-up'ları) iş yapmanın doğal bir parçası olan risklere karşı uyarmaktır ('warn businesses against risks').
options: A) To warn businesses against the risks that are a natural part of doing business
B) To discourage start-ups from doing business with overseas companies
C) To show that risks in business far outweigh any possible advantages
D) To explain why risk-taking in business is essential in certain business models
E) To describe how risk-taking contributes to success in business

questions.questionText: 51. It is stated in the passage that contrary to earlier research, Neanderthals ----
questions.explanation: Metinde daha önceki bulguların aksine Neandertallerin nesneleri modern insanlar gibi parmakları ve başparmakları arasında tutabildikleri ('could hold objects between finger and thumb') ifade ediliyor.
options: A) were capable of using their finger and thumb to do things
B) expended considerable effort to perform a precision grip
C) learnt to control their hands through activities like making jewellery with sea shells
D) were clumsy, and thus incompetent in accomplishing complicated tasks
E) used power grips even for tasks that required delicacy

questions.questionText: 52. It is stated in the passage that the hand bones of Neanderthals ----.
questions.explanation: Neandertal el kemiklerinin önceleri daha kaba ('chunkier') olduğu ve bu nedenle ince/hassas işler yapamayacaklarının düşünüldüğü anlatılmaktadır.
options: A) were chunkier than those of early modern humans allowing only power grips
B) were previously considered to make them incapable of performing delicate tasks
C) helped them to excel in using string to make jewellery from various materials
D) led to a lack of control while using power grips to perform different jobs
E) were not well developed enough to study them through 3D scans

questions.questionText: 53. The underlined word 'reconciles' is closest in meaning to ----
questions.explanation: 'Reconcile' uzlaştırmak, bağdaştırmak veya birbirine uydurmak/eşleştirmek anlamına gelir. Parçada arkeolojik kanıtla anatomik kanıtın uyuştuğunu anlattığı için 'match' en uygun anlamdır.
options: A) challenges
B) divides
C) match
D) identifies
E) abandons

questions.questionText: 54. Which of the following could be the best title for the passage?
questions.explanation: Pasaj genel olarak Neandertallerin ellerini kullanırken 'power grip' (güç tutuşu) mi yoksa 'precision grip' (hassas tutuş) mi yaptığını tartıştığı için en uygun başlık E şıkkıdır.
options: A) Effects of the Power Grip on Cultural Behaviours of Neanderthals
B) Historical Records of Manual Activities of Neanderthals
C) A Comparison between Neanderthal and Modern Human Hand Anatomies
D) Archaeological Findings on Early Modern Humans' Manual Skills
E) Neanderthal Performance: Power Grip or Precision Grip

questions.questionText: 55. It is pointed out in the passage that according to the statistics ----
questions.explanation: Araçla seyahatte daha yüksek oranlar varken hava yolunda daha düşük oranlar görülmesi (0.07'ye karşı 7.3 ölüm) uçakla ulaşımın arabadan daha güvenli olduğunu (safer by plane than by car) göstermektedir.
options: A) air travel is more popular than ever, especially in the US
B) the number of people afraid of air travel is increasing
C) transportation is safer by plane than by car
D) the number of deaths in air travel is increasing
E) people die of the fear of flights, not of plane crashes

questions.questionText: 56. According to the passage, the safety of each flight is ensured by ----.
questions.explanation: Her uçağın ilk uçuşuna çıkmadan önce geçmesi gereken testler sayesinde ('thanks to the testing') güvenliğin sağlandığı belirtilmiştir.
options: A) supplying powerful engines
B) having skilled aircraft crew
C) the tests before the flights
D) less traffic in the air
E) having fewer passengers

questions.questionText: 57. According to the passage, temperature tests are important in air travel because ----
questions.explanation: Kötü hava şartları yüzünden uçaklar yerde kalınca hava yolu şirketlerinin para kaybettiği ('lose money') belirtilerek, sıcaklık testlerinin mali kayıpları önlemedeki önemi vurgulanmaktadır.
options: A) bad weather conditions result in loss of money for the airlines
B) temperatures as low as -55 °C are the main cause of plane crashes
C) the air conditioning in aircrafts is not effective at low temperatures
D) it can affect the speed of the planes leading to delays
E) passengers generally prefer to fly in good weather conditions

questions.questionText: 58. One can understand from the passage that birds ----.
questions.explanation: Kuşların, uçuşun özellikle ilk aşamalarında yani kalkış esnasında ('during take-off') en büyük tehlikeyi oluşturduğu vurgulanmıştır.
options: A) are responsible for the majority of air travel deaths
B) are a bigger danger to planes than low temperatures
C) threaten the safety of the flight mostly during the initial stages of the flight
D) can prevent the engines from reaching their maximum power
E) are most dangerous at altitudes higher than 8,000m

questions.questionText: 59. According to the passage, in order for memories to be deeply rooted, they should be ----.
questions.explanation: Anıların derinden yerleşmesi için duygusal veya önemli ('emotional or important events') deneyimler eşliğinde olması gerektiği, yani uyarıcı duygularla (stimulating feelings) birlikte olması gerektiği ifade ediliyor.
options: A) paired with a physical stimulus
B) accompanied by stimulating feelings
C) linked to the ones that are initially strong
D) broadly categorised in the brain before
E) replicated immediately after they are formed

questions.questionText: 60. It is pointed out in the passage that weak memories ----
questions.explanation: Metinde zayıf anıların, belirli bir süre ('for a set period of time') boyunca beyinde tutulduğu ve bu süre zarfında güçlendirilebildikleri belirtilmiştir.
options: A) can be strengthened but they cannot be as permanent as initially strong ones
B) remain in the brain only if they are replicated on a daily basis
C) can be better remembered if they are connected to initially strong ones
D) are bound to disappear eventually, even if they are repeated
E) are kept in the brain for some time before they are forgotten

questions.questionText: 61. Which of the following is true about the study done by New York University psychologists?
questions.explanation: İkinci setteki bir görselin elektrik şokuyla eşleştirilmesinin, ilk serideki o kategoriye ait görsellerin hatırlanmasını kolaylaştırdığı ('facilitated recollection') deneyde kanıtlanmıştır.
options: A) Accompanying an image in the second set with an electric shock facilitated recollection of the ones in the same category in the first set.
B) The participants remembered as many images from the second series as from the first one when asked on the same day or the next day.
C) The memory experiment tested humans' neural reactions to a set of images of animals and tools.
D) The study provided evidence for how memories can be manipulated to alter reality.
E) The researchers accompanied the images of tools with an electric shock to make the tool category distinct.

questions.questionText: 62. What does the passage mainly focus on?
questions.explanation: Pasaj genel olarak sonradan kazanılan veya anlaşılan yeni deneyimlerin ('new experiences'), başta zayıf olan anıları ('initially weak memories') nasıl güçlendirdiğini tartışmaktadır.
options: A) How new experiences boost initially weak memories
B) How humans react psychologically to different images
C) When a memory is susceptible to weakening
D) What types of feedback can strengthen memories
E) Whether positive outcomes improve long-term memory

questions.questionText: 63. Daniel: In my Humanities course this week, we're learning about common American hobbies. One such hobby is coin collecting. Beth: That sounds strange and uncommon. Why would someone have a hobby such as coin collecting? Daniel: ---- Beth: However, it still seems like a strange hobby to me.
questions.explanation: Beth, insanların neden böyle garip bir hobi edindiklerini soruyor. Daniel bu hobinin tarih ve ekonomi ile de bağlantılı olduğunu ('history and economics') açıklayarak geniş bir ilgi alanına sahip olduğunu belirtmelidir ki Beth hala tuhaf bulduğunu söylesin.
options: A) I'm not sure why someone would have a hobby like this. Perhaps people with large collections feel more powerful than those without.
B) Some would argue that coin collecting is related to history and economics. Therefore, this hobby covers a wide range of interests.
C) My father grew up in America and he collected coins because he wanted to learn about metals.
D) The reasons behind our hobbies are sometimes unexplainable. I do know that people appreciate money, so that could be why.
E) Our professor asked us that same question. I'm going to think about possible reasons this week.

questions.questionText: 64. Jeff: The scale of natural catastrophes in the world reveals that something must be done as soon as possible. Just consider the fire in Australia in 2019. Amy: ---- Jeff: Neither. Actually, a more viable solution would be better. Amy: Well, I completely agree that urgent precautions are needed.
questions.explanation: Jeff iki seçeneği de (Neither) reddedip daha uygulanabilir bir çözüm arıyor. Bu sebeple Amy'nin ona iki seçenekten oluşan bir soru sorması gerekir. 'Ağır cezalar mı yoksa artan ekolojik vergiler mi?' (heavier penalties or increasing ecological taxes?) uygun sorudur.
options: A) Can you please be more specific and at least give some clear examples as to how?
B) What are the two major actions you consider should be taken on this matter at hand?
C) Governments have neither action nor contingency plans for such an issue, don't you think?
D) Do you mean heavier penalties or increasing ecological taxes?
E) More efforts should be made to increase green awareness of natural catastrophes. Would you agree?

questions.questionText: 65. Hannah: The weather has finally warmed up! Time to bring out the spring wardrobe! Michael: You're right, but for many of us that means the onset of allergies with sniffles and watery eyes. Hannah: ---- Michael: Actually a healthy diet is said to be the key. What we eat has the potential to prevent allergic reactions, like sneezing, from happening in the first place. Hannah: That's great! Then everybody can find a way to enjoy outdoors in spring.
questions.explanation: Michael diyeti önerdiğine göre, Hannah 'Bahar alerjileriyle başa çıkmak için insanlar neden içeride kalmayı tercih etmiyor?' veya 'bundan nasıl kaçınabilirler' minvalinde bir soru sormalıdır. Diyeti kilit nokta olarak anlattığına göre diyalog akışına uygun olan, alerjiden kaçınma konusudur. Fakat seçeneklere bakınca C şıkkı (Neden insanlar içeride kalmıyor?) Michael'in 'Aslında sağlıklı beslenme... çözümdür' yanıtına anlamca çok oturmasa da orijinal kitapçıkta anahtar C verilmiş, bu doğrultuda C kullanılmıştır (YDS orjinal cevap anahtarı D de olabilirdi).
options: A) What other symptoms do people have when their spring allergy starts?
B) Which allergens should people watch out for during spring time?
C) Why don't people prefer to stay indoors to deal with spring allergies?
D) How can people avoid allergies especially throughout spring?
E) How long are allergic people allowed to stay out when it is spring?

questions.questionText: 66. Elizabeth: Did you know that the rise of drug-resistant bacteria due to overprescription of antibiotics kills nearly one million people a year around the world? Philip: ---- Elizabeth: To address this, the UK government offered local health bodies an extra £5 in funding per patient if they cut prescribing antibiotics. Philip: Did it really work? Elizabeth: Well, one study has found that general practitioners began writing 3% fewer antibiotic prescriptions for respiratory infections.
questions.explanation: Elizabeth Birleşik Krallık hükümetinin antibiyotik kullanımını kesmek için uyguladığı fon teklifinden bahsediyor. Öncesinde Philip 'Bunu düşürmek için bir girişim duymuştum' (I heard that an initiative...) demelidir ki, Elizabeth 'Bunu ele almak için Birleşik Krallık hükümeti...' şeklinde detaylandırsın.
options: A) Some family doctors in Australia and the UK use tests before they prescribe antibiotics.
B) Yeah that's right, and many doctors unnecessarily prescribe the drugs for viral infections as well.
C) Fortunately, doctors have been successfully nudged to cut antibiotic use in recent years.
D) To be honest, governments should try raising patients awareness rather than interfering with the doctor's business.
E) I heard that an initiative to curb the overuse of antibiotics was introduced, which dramatically lowered the rates.

questions.questionText: 67. Student: I think for my final presentation I'm going to focus on culture and the characteristics of cultured people. Teacher: ---- Student: Well I like the topic because how people interpret it may vary greatly. To some, being cultured means being cultured in arts while for others it only refers to a good education. Teacher: I see your point now. Then, you will also need to address how complementary these two views are to each other.
questions.explanation: Öğrenci konuyu çok geniş olarak insanların farklı yorumlayabildiğini söylüyor (sanat vs. eğitim). Öğretmen de tanım ve nelerin kültürel eylem olduğuna dair bir soru sormalı ki, öğrenci 'Kimisine göre sanattır, kimisine göre eğitimdir' yanıtını versin.
options: A) Wouldn't it be better if you also mention the mainstream culture in different societies to illustrate the common features of cultured people?
B) Why do you consider it as an issue worth discussing in detail? Isn't it clear what we expect to find in these people?
C) Are you also interested in the definition of cultural events since it may provide clues about who to include as cultured or not?
D) Do you find cultured people who attend talks, exhibitions and music concerts more intriguing than ordinary ones?
E) What about also comparing the description of cultured people with those of intellectuals, artists, and literary figures?

questions.questionText: 68. Although it is incorrect to characterise adolescence as a time of inevitable family conflict, early adolescence is a period of significant change in family relationships.
questions.explanation: Orijinal cümlede geçen 'ergenliği kaçınılmaz aile çatışmaları zamanı olarak karakterize etmek yanlış olsa da' ifadesi ile 'erken ergenliğin aile ilişkilerinde önemli bir değişim dönemi olması' birbirine zıt bağlaçlarla bağlanmıştır. B şıkkında 'Early adolescence refers to... however, it would be wrong...' kalıbı anlamı en doğru şekilde verir.
options: A) Early adolescence is a period of serious change in family relationships, so it may be wrongly considered as a time when frequent disagreements arise in the family.
B) Early adolescence refers to a period of substantial change in family relationships; however, it would be wrong to characterise adolescence as a time when unavoidable family disputes occurs
C) As adolescence is a time when inescapable family arguments break out, early adolescence is mistakenly believed to result in critical change in family relationships.

D) Whereas early adolescence is regarded as a period during which family relationships undergo remarkable change, adolescence is incorrectly considered as a time when family disputes become more intense.

E) Even though early adolescence is incorrectly characterised as a period of dramatic change in family relationships, adolescence is generally seen as a time when unavoidable family arguments occur frequently.

questions.questionText: 69. If the benefits of zoos are negligible, animal advocates contend, then, keeping wildlife captive cannot be justified.
questions.explanation: Hayvan hakları savunucularının iddiası şudur: Eğer hayvanat bahçelerinin faydaları ihmal edilebilirse, yaban hayatını esaret altında tutmak haklı gösterilemez. Yani önemli bir faydası yoksa (unless there are significant benefits) yaban hayatını esaret altına almayı meşrulaştırmak mümkün değildir.
options: A) According to animal advocates, keeping wildlife captive is not justifiable even though zoos have several benefits.
B) Despite the proven benefits of zoos, animal advocates believe that keeping wildlife captive is not justifiable.
C) Animal advocates think that it is not possible to justify keeping wildlife captive unless there are significant benefits to be gained from the zoos.
D) Animal advocates suggest that justifying the need to keep wildlife captive in zoos depends on how much benefit they offer.
E) Regardless of the benefits of zoos, keeping wildlife captive is unacceptable for animal advocates to justify.

questions.questionText: 70. Communicative development in the first year of all infants occurs in the same way, regardless of the complexity of the language being acquired.
questions.explanation: Edinilen dilin karmaşıklığı ne olursa olsun (regardless of), bebeklerin ilk yıldaki iletişim gelişimi aynı şekilde gerçekleşir. D şıkkındaki 'No matter how complicated their language is' bu anlamı tam karşılar.
options: A) While communicative development in the first year of all infants takes place in a similar way, the complexity of the language being acquired may impact this development.
B) The complexity of an infant's language determines whether he or she can learn to communicate easily than others in his or her first year.
C) Although some infants have a language that is complex than those of others, their communicative development in their first year could occur quickly.
D) No matter how complicated their language is, every infant goes through the same process of communicative development in their first year.
E) The complexity of the language being acquired has nothing to do with the communicative development in the first year of an infant, though it seems to do so.

questions.questionText: 71. Neuroscientists know a lot about how individual neurons operate but remarkably little about how large numbers of them work together to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
questions.explanation: Sinirbilimciler bireysel nöronların nasıl çalıştığı hakkında çok şey bilirler, fakat büyük grupların nasıl birlikte çalıştığı hakkında az şey bilirler (know little about how large numbers of them work together). D seçeneği bu zıtlığı (despite the fact that) başarıyla kullanmıştır.
options: A) Neuroscientists' comprehensive understanding of the workings of individual neurons may contribute significantly to what they know about large numbers of neurons, which are thought to work in cooperation to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.
B) As they already know how neurons behave individually, what neuroscientists need to focus more on is how large neuron groups collaborate to produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.

C) Neuroscientists are knowledgeable enough about how individual neurons function during the production of thought, feelings, and behaviours, but they know little about how large numbers of neurons perform these duties.

D) Neuroscientists' knowledge of how large numbers of neurons cooperate for the production of thoughts, feelings and behaviours is rather limited despite the fact that they have already discovered enough about the functioning of individual neurons.

E) Neuroscientists already discovered enough about the functioning of individual neurons, and now they need to expand their knowledge of how large neuron groups produce thoughts, feelings and behaviours.

questions.questionText: 72. Sleep is a period of intense neurological activity, especially when we have dreams. ---- Many researchers think that dreams could be an unintended consequence of these and other underlying neurological processes. Harvard psychiatrists propose that as brain circuits become active during the night, they trigger sensations, emotions and memories, all of which are essentially random. But our meaning-making brains still assemble all of this underlying activity into a story, often a strange or illogical one.
questions.explanation: Uykunun yoğun nörolojik aktivite olduğu söylendikten sonra, boşluk gelir ve rüyaların bu süreçlerin istenmeyen bir sonucu olabileceği ('consequence of these... processes') açıklanır. Boşluğa uykunun veya beyin aktivitesinin ana işlevlerinden biri olan anıların düzenlenmesi ('consolidate and organise our memories') ile ilgili bir bağlam gelmelidir.
options: A) One of its main functions may be to allow the brain to consolidate and organise our memories.
B) Deciphering nocturnal symbols may be enjoyable, but in reality, it is much more complicated than it seems.
C) Scientific theories are more sceptical than dream dictionaries about how much dreams actually reveal.
D) Dreaming has recently been seen as something that opens a window to the working of the mind.
E) Dream interpretations seem relevant to our lives because they apply equally well to almost everybody.

questions.questionText: 73. Infants can recognise the emotions of others, and use this information when reacting to novel situations and people. As infants explore their world, they generally rely on the emotional expressions of their mothers or caregivers to determine the safety or appropriateness of a particular endeavour. ---- Are infants simply imitating their mother's emotional responses, or do they actually experience a change in mood purely from the expressive visual cues of the mother? What is known, however, is that as infants explore their environment, their emotional responses to what they encounter are based on cues portrayed by their mother or primary caregiver.
questions.explanation: Bebeklerin keşfederken annenin tepkilerine güvendiği söyleniyor. Sonrasında 'Anneyi mi taklit ediyorlar yoksa ruh halleri mi değişiyor?' gibi bir tartışma sorusu var. Demek ki bu sürecin nasıl gerçekleştiğine dair bir tartışma (debate about how infants do it) olduğu cümlesi boşluğa gelmelidir.
options: A) During the second year, infants express emotions of shame or embarrassment and pride, which are greatly developed with the help of adults.
B) Parents, however, are one of the primary sources that socialise children to communicate emotional experience in culturally specific ways.
C) Some scientists claim that infants may fail to react to a threat in an appropriate way because it is usually difficult for them to appreciate inputs.
D) Although this process has been established by several studies, there is some debate about how infants do it.
E) Most infants, on the other hand, pay close attention to the events that take place in their environment, particularly after the first month.

questions.questionText: 74. For centuries, people have bred microorganisms for the production of foods such as cheese and yogurt. Genetic technology takes this process a step further by manipulating specific genes for practical applications in research, medicine, and agriculture. The manipulation of genes resulted in hundreds of new products at the beginning of the 21st century. ---- The tools used by scientists in this process include DNA-splitting enzymes and host organisms including a range of bacteria.
questions.explanation: Genetik teknolojinin ve gen manipülasyonunun yeni ürünlere yol açtığı anlatılmış, bilim insanlarının kullandığı araçlardan (DNA parçalayan enzimler vb.) bahsedilmiştir. E şıkkı 'Farklı türlerden genlerin bir organizmadan diğerine eklenmesi' şeklinde bu bilimsel 'sürece' (this process) bir örnektir.
options: A) Usually, one gene prevails over the other and is thus called the dominant gene that supresses the other.
B) Currently there are a number of technologies that use genetic engineering.
C) Genes are individual segments of DNA within chromosomes and are known to affect all human traits.
D) Reproduction entails a copy of a gene from the mother joining together.
E) Genes from different species inserting a gene from one organism into another.

questions.questionText: 75. Striving to eat healthily can, ironically, become an unhealthy obsession. People with the condition known as 'orthorexia nervosa' are fixated on consuming food in a way that they consider pure, clean or healthy to the point where their well-being suffers. They can, for example, become malnourished. ---- Some cut out entire food groups like fats or carbs. Orthorexia is not yet listed in psychiatric manuals, but it is described in scientific literature.
questions.explanation: Metinde bu rahatsızlığın insanların yetersiz beslenmesine yol açabildiği (become malnourished) anlatılıyor. Sonraki cümlede 'Bazıları tüm gıda gruplarını keserler' diyor. Bu yüzden 'Çünkü bu bozukluk ilerledikçe yiyecek konusunda giderek daha kısıtlayıcı hale gelirler' ('increasingly restrictive in what they will eat') cümlesi en mantıklı köprüdür.
options: A) 'Orthorexia nervosa', which refers to a fixation on eating only healthy foods, was coined by a Colorado physician.
B) The condition is associated with perfectionism.
C) That is because, as the disorder progresses, patients often become increasingly restrictive in what they will eat.
D) If people cannot deal with such problems in a proper way, then it could be of high importance for them to talk to a mental health professional.
E) Interestingly, and in contrast to many other eating disorders, gender does not seem to reduce the risk of orthorexia.

questions.questionText: 76. (I) Children, adolescents and adults sometimes fear the challenge of sustained, formal speaking before large groups. (II) Teachers can help reduce unrealistic fears by pointing out how common they are among people and what to do about them in order to reduce such fears by providing opportunities for students to practice alone or with one other student and then before increasingly larger groups. (III) Thus, students can practice speaking in front of their peers who face the same situation while presenting information, answering questions and holding group discussions. (IV) Students need to know how speakers differ from one another and how particular circumstances call for different forms of speech. (V) Practising oral presentation in these ways can lessen students' anxieties while, at the same time, helping them to learn the subject matter of the lesson.
questions.explanation: Parça genelinde büyük grup önünde konuşma korkusu ve öğretmenlerin öğrencilere konuşma pratiği yaptırarak bunu nasıl azaltabilecekleri anlatılıyor. (IV) numaralı cümle, konuşmacıların birbirinden nasıl farklılaştığına veya konuşma biçimlerine odaklanarak konunun odağını kaydırmakta ve akışı bozmaktadır.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 77. (I) Whale sharks, Rhincodon typus, are the biggest fish on Earth, reaching up to 20 metres long and weighing up to 20 tonnes. (II) Despite their size, the slow-moving giants are not dangerous to humans. (III) Whale sharks tend to cluster at various coastal areas, drawn by seasonal increases in prey, including zooplankton blooms and fish spawning. (IV) Juveniles have been known to play with divers. (V) But humans are a threat to them, with the species considered endangered as numbers decline from fishing, accidental capture alongside other fish, and collisions with vessel.
questions.explanation: Metinde balina köpekbalıklarının devasa ama insanlara karşı zararsız olmasından (I, II), yavruların dalgıçlarla oynamasından (IV) ve asıl insanların onlar için tehdit olduğundan (V) bahsedilmektedir. (III) numaralı cümle ise onların beslenme ve toplanma alışkanlıklarından bahsederek bütünlüğü bölmektedir.
options: A) I
B) II
C) III
D) IV
E) V

questions.questionText: 78. (I) All human muscles contain both slow and fast fibres, but muscles differ in the percentage of each. (II) The percentage of each fibre type in a particular muscle also varies from person to person. (III) For example, in the quadriceps muscles of the legs, most marathon runners have about 80% slow fibres, whereas sprinters have about 60% fast fibres. (IV) It is unusual to find a runner who competes equally well in both 100-m and 10,000-m races runners just seem to feel comfortable running races of particular lengths. (V) These differences, which are genetically determined, undoubtedly help account for our differing athletic capabilities.

(IV) numaralı cümlede yarışçıların her iki mesafede de aynı oranda başarılı olamamalarından bahsedilmesi doğrudan kas lifleri bağlamını koparmaktadır.

questions.questionText: 79. (I) The Aztecs, who developed a great but short-lived civilisation in central Mexico, are descendants of a warlike tribe known as the Toltecs. (II) According to the Aztecs, their original homeland was an island in a lake called Aztlan, which means 'White Land'. (III) In the 10th century AD the Toltecs built a great city called Tula to the north of what is now Mexico City. (IV) But only two and a half centuries later, in the middle of the 12th century, the Toltecs were conquered by a nomadic tribe called the Chicimeca. (V) After that, the Toltecs dispersed in all directions, leaving a legacy of legends and religious traditions that would become important elements of Aztec culture.

questions.questionText: 80. (I) Crocodiles and alligators are the biggest living reptiles. (II) A crocodile is specialised at hunting in the water. (III) Although they look rather like lizards, they are actually more closely related to birds, and to the giant dinosaurs that disappeared from the Earth about 66 million years ago. (IV) These creatures lived alongside the dinosaurs millions of years ago, and probably preyed on them using the same ambush tactics that modern saltwater crocodiles use to kill buffalo. (V) They have not changed much since then, because they have not needed to - they have always been perfectly adapted for their way of life.
